text:
Ajay K: Hey team — onboarding request for a new customer org (AuroraAI). Need cross-cloud account + quota checklist. I sketched requirements below, please chime in with gaps.

Maria P: +1. Quick list of what AuroraAI needs: production ML clusters in GCP (us-central1 + europe-west4), AWS (us-east-1), and Azure (westeurope). Starting traffic estimate ~100 QPS inference, 5k tokens/sec.

Liz Zhao: GPUs: they want A100 (or A10s for cost fallback) across regions. We should capture per-cloud quota reqs, vCPU limits for preemptible/spot pools, and external IPs for edge workers.

Sam H: Also network: need NAT gateways, VPN/Interconnect, /27s for control plane, and peering for on-prem ingestion. Egress budget will matter — call out expected TB/month.

Kevin B: I'll add cost/reservation options later (RI/Committed use). For now, template items: org/folder/project structure, billing account link, labels/tags, IAM roles, service accounts, KMS, and monitoring export.

Ajay K: Draft checklist (comments inline):
- Organize: create Org node "auroraai" and folder structure: folders/ml-prod, ml-staging, infra.
- Billing: attach billing account (billing-id) to projects; create budget alerts: 1x dev, 5x staging, 10x prod thresholds.
- Projects: project-aurora-prod, -staging, -shared-services.
- Tags/labels: team=ml, cost_center=AUR-42, env=prod/stage/dev, owner:email.
- IAM: bootstrap TF service account with roles: roles/resourcemanager.projectCreator, roles/billing.user, roles/iam.serviceAccountUser, roles/compute.admin (GCP); AWS: OrganizationAccountAccessRole + IAM role for CI; Azure: Owner for subscription admins.
- APIs: enable compute, compute.googleapis.com, iam.googleapis.com, cloudkms.googleapis.com, monitoring.googleapis.com.
- Networking: shared VPC host project, subnet ranges (avoid 10.0.0.0/8 clashes), Cloud NAT config for egress, firewall baseline (allow control plane SSH from SRE IPs, deny wide 0.0.0.0/0 for mgmt).
- On-prem connectivity: VPN + BGP config placeholders + CDN points.
- KMS: customer-managed keys, key rotations, grant service account access.
- Logging/observability: export to project-shared-logs, retention 365d for audit logs.

Maria P: GCP quota specifics to request now: GPUs per region (A100) = 20 per region (us-central1, europe-west4), GPUs per project = 40, vCPU quota increase to 10k in those projects, static external IPs increase to 50, internal IP ranges for alias IPs. Also request GPUs be added to allowed accelerators for projects.

Liz Zhao: AWS specifics: new account in OU "customers/auroraai". EC2 GPU quotas: p4d.xlarge/p4d family quota 8 instances initial, allow bursting to 32. ENI limit increase in us-east-1, Elastic IPs 50, ENA versions pinned. Request service quotas for EC2 On-Demand vCPU to 8k. Also request IAM role trust for our cross-account deploy role.

Sam H: Azure specifics: subscription, resource groups for prod/staging. Request NCas/NDas quotas (for A100-equivalent SKUs) increase to 24 cores initially, cores quota bump in the subscription to 6k, public IPs to 40, and load balancer backend pool limits. Ensure Microsoft Support ticket template used for quota increases.

Ajay K: Network limits across clouds:
- GCP: Cloud NAT ephemeral IP pools, Cloud Router BGP ASN options, VPC quota for routes + firewall rules default.
- AWS: VPC CIDR sizing, ENI attachment limits, route table entries, NAT gateway throughput and cost implications.
- Azure: UD and SNAT ports on NAT gateway, public IP SKUs.

Kevin B: Cost notes: likely 6–8 A100-equivalents across regions initially. Recommend reserved instances / committed use discounts for steady baseline (30–50% savings). I'll prepare a quick 12-month TCO with on-demand vs reserved.

Liz Zhao: We should also add infra-policy items: organization policy to restrict allowed machine types (allowlist), restrict region to approved regions list, disable project-level service account key creation.

Ajay K: Ticket templates — please use these when filing quota requests. Copy/paste and fill placeholders.

---
GCP quota request template:
Subject: Quota increase request for AuroraAI (org: auroraai) — GPUs + vCPU + static IPs

Body:
Project: project-aurora-prod
Billing account: 0123-4567-89
Regions: us-central1, europe-west4
Requested changes:
- GPUs (A100/smi): +20 per region (total 40)
- vCPU quota: increase to 10000 for project-aurora-prod
- Static external IPs: +50
- Enable accelerators for project and grant service account compute-sa@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com access to use accelerators
Use case: low-latency inference fleet for production customers, sustained 5k tokens/sec, code: inference. Estimated monthly GPU hours: 6k.
Contact: Ajay K, ajay@redwood.com

AWS quota request template:
Subject: EC2 quota increases for AuroraAI account (OU: customers/auroraai)

Body:
Account ID: 123456789012
Regions: us-east-1
Requested changes:
- p4d family instances increase: from 0 -> 32 instances
- vCPU limit: increase to 8000
- Elastic IPs: +50
- ENI limits: increase per-instance if needed
Rationale: production ML inference fleet. Contact: Liz Zhao, liz@redwood.com

Azure quota request template:
Subject: Quota increase for AuroraAI subscription - GPU cores/public IPs

Body:
Subscription ID: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx
Regions: westeurope
Requested changes:
- GPU cores (NDv4/NCv3 equivalents): +24
- vCPU cores: increase to 6000
- Public IPs: +40
Contact: Sam H, sam@redwood.com
---

Maria P: Added: tagging convention. Please use the following labels on all resources: 
- redwood:owner=email
- redwood:team=ml
- redwood:env=prod/stage/dev
- billing:cost_center=AUR-42

Ajay K: Quick commands we run to validate bootstrap (examples):
- gcloud: 
```
gcloud projects create project-aurora-prod --name=aurora-prod --folder=1234567890
gcloud services enable compute.googleapis.com iam.googleapis.com --project=project-aurora-prod
```
- aws: 
```
aws organizations create-account --email infra+aurora@redwood.com --account-name aurora-ml
aws iam create-role --role-name RedwoodDeployRole --assume-role-policy-document file://trust.json
```

Liz Zhao: Security checkpoint: enable access transparency logs where possible, add KMS key for disk encryption, enforce VPC flow logs to central logging.

Ajay K: Next steps:
1) Liz to file AWS support quota ticket using template (ETA 4h)
2) Maria to file GCP quota request + open support case (ETA EOD)
3) Sam to file Azure quota increase (ETA tomorrow)
4) Kevin to publish 12-month cost estimate (ETA 48h)

quota-bot: Created internal ticket INFRA-2029 for AuroraAI cross-cloud quota coordination. Assigned to eng-infra.

infra-bot: Noted — please paste support case numbers here once created. I'll attach to INFRA-2029.

Kevin B: FYI — consider pre-booking A100 zones or using region fallback to A10s while increases propagate. Also watch spot/preemptible eviction rates.

Maria P: Filed GCP case: Case 987654321 — requested A100 quotas and vCPUs. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/987654321

Liz Zhao: AWS ticket submitted: Ticket #1209873 — p4d limit increase requested to 32 in us-east-1.

Sam H: Azure quota request opened: SR 445677 — requested GPU cores and public IP increase in westeurope.

Ajay K: Great — I'll update INFRA-2029 with those refs and start the org/project creation once billing is attached. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Kevin B: Leaving a note — for cost attribution, please set billing export to BigQuery (GCP) and enable cost management on AWS and Azure. We'll hook those into cost dashboards.

Maria P: One small follow-up: audit requirement — AuroraAI asked for 3-year retention for some audit logs. Confirmed we can set storage lifecycle and retention on the logging bucket.

Ajay K: Closing check-in. If anything else appears, post here and we'll loop in security/compliance.

Sam H: ack.
